content.text: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded, Gen. 6:22. thou hast obeyed my voice, Gen. 22:18. Abraham obeyed my voice, Gen. 26:5. if ye will obey my voice, Ex. 19:5. All that the Lord hath said will we do, and be obedient, Ex. 24:7. Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, Lev. 18:26. If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, Lev. 26:3 (Deut. 4:40). if ye walk contrary unto me … I will bring … plagues, Lev. 26:21. we will hear it, and do it, Deut. 5:27. Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it, Deut. 6:3. man doth not live by bread only, but by every word … of the Lord, Deut. 8:3 (Matt. 4:4; D&C 84:44). If thou wilt not observe to do all the words, Deut. 28:58. love the Lord … obey his voice, Deut. 30:20. God will we serve, and his voice will we obey, Josh. 24:24. people refused to obey the voice of Samuel, 1 Sam. 8:19. to obey is better than sacrifice, 1 Sam. 15:22. do according unto all that which is written, 2 Kgs. 22:13. if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, Job 36:12. have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, Prov. 5:13. Fear God, and keep his commandments, Eccl. 12:13 (John 14:15, 21; Rev. 22:14; 2 Ne. 1:9; D&C 5:22; 11:20). be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land, Isa. 1:19. Obey my voice, and I will be your God, Jer. 7:23. Obey my voice, and do … all which I command you, Jer. 11:4. all dominions shall serve and obey him, Dan. 7:27. that they might not obey thy voice, Dan. 9:11. ye shall know … if ye will diligently obey the voice of the Lord, Zech. 6:15.

Not every one … but he that doeth the will, Matt. 7:21 (3 Ne. 14:21). heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth, Matt. 7:24 (3 Ne. 14:24). winds and the sea obey him, Matt. 8:27 (Mark 4:41; Luke 8:25). not as I will, but as thou wilt, Matt. 26:39. unclean spirits … do obey him, Mark 1:27. blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it, Luke 11:28. If any man will do his will, he shall know, John 7:17. I do always those things that please him, John 8:29. keep my commandments … abide in my love, John 15:10 (1 Jn. 2:5). obey God rather than men, Acts 5:29. To whom our fathers would not obey, Acts 7:39. obedience to the faith among all nations, Rom. 1:5 (16:26). them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, Rom. 2:8. by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous, Rom. 5:19. his servants ye are to whom ye obey, Rom. 6:16. commanded to be under obedience, 1 Cor. 14:34. he remembereth the obedience of you all, 2 Cor. 7:15. bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience, 2 Cor. 10:5. that ye should not obey the truth, Gal. 3:1 (5:7). Children, obey your parents, Eph. 6:1 (Col. 3:20). vengeance on them that … obey not the gospel, 2 Thes. 1:8. obedient to their own husbands, Titus 2:5. Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, Titus 2:9. Put them in mind … to obey magistrates, Titus 3:1. learned he obedience by the things which he suffered, Heb. 5:8. By faith Abraham, when he was called … obeyed, Heb. 11:8. Obey them that have the rule over you, Heb. 13:17. bits in the horses’ mouths, that they may obey, James 3:3. Elect … unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood, 1 Pet. 1:2. As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves, 1 Pet. 1:14. husbands … if any obey not the word, 1 Pet. 3:1. Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, 1 Pet. 3:6. what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel, 1 Pet. 4:17.

I will go and do the things which the Lord hath commanded, 1 Ne. 3:7. I did obey the voice of the Spirit, 1 Ne. 4:18. he would be obedient unto him in keeping his commandments, 2 Ne. 31:7. Lord commanded me, and I must obey, 2 Ne. 33:15. him who listeth to obey that spirit, Mosiah 2:33 (Alma 3:26–27; D&C 29:45). be obedient unto the end of your lives, Mosiah 5:8. they did obey … that their mothers had taught them, Alma 57:21.

he that will not obey shall be cut off, D&C 56:3. I command and men obey not, D&C 58:32. confess not his hand … and obey not his commandments, D&C 59:21. Lord, utter my voice, and it shall be obeyed, D&C 63:5. willing and obedient shall eat, D&C 64:34. bound when ye do what I say, D&C 82:10. obeyeth my voice, and keepeth my commandments, D&C 93:1. if ye observe to do whatsoever I command you, D&C 98:22. hearkening to observe all the words which I … shall speak, D&C 103:7. people must needs be chastened until they learn obedience, D&C 105:6. obtain any blessing … by obedience to that law upon which it is predicated, D&C 130:21. ye obeyed not my voice when I called to you, D&C 133:71. by obedience to the principles of the gospel, D&C 138:4.

Adam was obedient unto the commandments, Moses 5:5. to see if they will do all things whatsoever the Lord … shall command, Abr. 3:25. Gods saw they would obey, Abr. 4:25. saved, by obedience to the laws and ordinances, A of F 1:3. We believe in … obeying, honoring, and sustaining the law, A of F 1:12.
